title: ETH正在消失！交易所可卖代币创历史新低，长线持有者主导市场
subTitle:
以太坊正在悄悄“变少”
最近一段时间，以太坊链上出现了一个非常值得关注的变化：交易所里的 ETH 正在持续减少，而且已经降到了 2016 年以来的最低水平。这背后，并不是散户在恐慌性抛售，反而更像是一场由机构和长期持有者主导的“悄悄囤币”。
随着机构、企业和#etf 不断增加对以太坊的配置需求，越来越多的ETH被转出交易所，进入冷钱包、质押合约或长期储备账户，市场结构正在发生变化。

交易所ETH供应跌到历史低位
根据 CryptoQuant 提供的链上数据，目前交易所供应比率（ESR）已经降至约 0.137，这意味着只有不到 14% 的ETH还留在交易所中，这是自 2016 年以太坊早期阶段以来从未出现过的水平。
在交易量最大的币安，情况更加明显，ETH 的 ESR 已下降至 0.032 左右，说明可随时用于交易和抛售的ETH数量正在快速减少。这通常不是短线交易活跃的信号，而更像是筹码被“锁走”的阶段。

抛售意愿正在减弱
CryptoQuant 分析师 Arab Chain 指出，当前ETH正在持续从交易所净流出，流向私人钱包和链上协议。这种走势往往出现在市场经历波动之后，当抛压减轻、资金开始重新吸收流动性时，持有者更倾向于长期布局，而不是频繁进出市场。
从 2024 年中到现在，整体交易所的 ESR 指标一路下滑，与此同时，ETH价格却在高位区间和回调区间反复震荡，这种背离说明卖盘在减少，但市场仍在等待新的催化剂。
PoS和质押正在“锁死” #ETH 
以太坊转向权益证明机制后，质押行为成为重要变量。目前已有接近 3600 万枚 ETH 被质押，这些代币需要从交易所转移到专用钱包或协议中，短期内无法流通。
换句话说，越来越多的ETH被系统性地锁定起来，这不仅减少了市场流通量，也改变了投资者的行为模式，从“随时可卖”转向“长期收益型持有”。
Layer 2正在分流流动性
除了质押之外，Layer 2 生态的发展同样在影响ETH的分布。像 Base、Arbitrum、Optimism 这样的二层网络，吸引了大量资金和用户，把ETH从中心化交易所转移到链上和去中心化交易所中。

经历过 FTX 崩溃之后，越来越多用户选择自托管资产，DEX 和链上协议的使用频率持续上升，这进一步压缩了交易所里的ETH存量。
机构正在系统性布局以太坊
链上数据显示，目前大约有 67 家上市公司、政府机构和组织将以太坊作为储备资产，总共持有约 671 万枚 ETH，价值接近 190 亿美元。同时，以太坊ETF持有的ETH数量也已超过 622 万枚，占总供应量的比例持续上升。
这些资金并不追求短期波动，而是更偏向长期配置，这也是交易所ETH供应持续下降的重要原因。
结语：供应紧张，长期逻辑仍在
交易所ETH变少、机构需求增加，正在共同塑造一个“低流动性、高需求”的市场环境。短期价格可能仍会受到宏观和情绪影响，但从结构上看，ETH的长期供需关系正在逐步收紧。
当卖盘越来越少，而长期买盘持续存在时，市场最终需要用价格来重新平衡这一切。以太坊或许正在为下一阶段行情，慢慢积蓄力量。

Is XRP crashing? The sustained break below $2 signals trouble

XRP's price chart paints a bearish picture, but a softer-than-expected U.S. inflation could spark a rebound.

XRP bears have finally established a solid foothold below the $2 support.

This may draw more sellers to the market, potentially yielding a deeper slide.

That's what typically happens in markets when a long-held price support finally gives way, unleashing disgruntled holders who flood the market with supply, overwhelming buyers and driving prices sharply lower.
XRP's support breakdown

The above description fits perfectly with payments-focused cryptocurrency XRP, whose prices have finally established a foothold below the long-held $2.00 support.

Since January this year, prices dipped below that level several times but never stayed there for more than two daily candles, quickly rebounding in a V-shaped recovery as shown in the chart below.
But now it appears to have found solid footing: prices fell below $2.00 on Sunday and have stayed there since, marking a true technical breakdown of this key level. XRP is used by fintech company Ripple to facilitate cross-border transactions.
Bearish signals pile up

Other indicators back the bearish outlook. For instance, the widely tracked 50-, 100-, and 200-day simple moving averages (SMAs) are all trending lower, showing bearish momentum in both short- and long-term trends.

The MACD histogram, an indicator used to gauge momentum and trend changes, keeps printing deeper bars below the zero line, signaling strengthening downside pressure.

The support break, coupled with bearish moving averages, points to potential for a further decline toward $1.63, the 61.8% Fibonacci retracement of XRP's bull market rally from the 2024 low of 43 cents to the 2025 record high of $3.66.

title: I want to share something honest with all of you today, not as a trader on a screen,
subTitle:
but as a human being behind it. Lately, I’ve realized that I may have overestimated myself. The level of attention, expectations, and traffic that comes with live trading is heavier than it looks from the outside. I truly believed that if I worked hard enough and stayed sincere, I could satisfy everyone. But the reality is different. Losses bring criticism, and criticism slowly eats at the mindset if you’re not careful.

I am still young, and that’s something I have to accept with humility. In trading, I can be extremely rational, disciplined, and almost machine-like. I follow rules, probabilities, and data. But when it comes to people, emotions are harder to control. Words hit differently. Accusations hurt. And sometimes, even when you know you did nothing wrong, the weight still stays with you.

Behind every trader, every viewer, every critic, there is a family. I never forget that. As someone who trades live, my deepest wish is always the same: I want every trade to end in profit for everyone watching. But that expectation itself is unrealistic. Losses are not a possibility in trading; they are a certainty. And unfortunately, every loss also invites judgment.

Last night was especially difficult for me. It was the biggest loss I’ve faced since starting live trading — 60 points on Ethereum. I felt guilty, not because losses are abnormal, but because I know people trust me. At the same time, I was deeply moved by the messages of support from loyal viewers who understood the situation and stood by me. That support matters more than you may realize.

I still believe in my trading ability. That confidence has not disappeared. What I need to work on is my mindset during losses, especially in a public environment. Live trading is not easy. It tests not only your strategy, but your emotions, patience, and character.

Even so, I continue for one simple reason. I still hope you can win. Even if the probability is small. Even if the road is hard. That belief is what keeps me going.

title: Ethereum : Vitalik Kêu Gọi “Đơn Giản Hóa” – ETH Sẽ Bay Cao ? Khi Nào ?
subTitle:
Trong bối cảnh Ethereum ngày càng trở nên phức tạp với hàng loạt Layer 2, restaking, MEV, RPC tập trung. Vitalik Buterin bất ngờ lên tiếng kêu gọi cộng đồng đưa Ethereum quay về tinh thần cốt lõi: đơn giản – dễ kiểm chứng – phi tín nhiệm thực sự.
Thông điệp này không mới nếu nhìn vào triết lý ban đầu của Vitalik, nhưng việc ông nhấn mạnh nó ở thời điểm Ethereum đang bước sâu vào giai đoạn mở rộng quy mô bằng Layer 2 khiến cộng đồng và nhà đầu tư phải suy nghĩ lại.
Ethereum hôm nay nhanh hơn, rẻ hơn, nhiều ứng dụng hơn — nhưng người dùng lại phải tin vào ngày càng nhiều bên trung gian như : 
RPC tập trungSequencer của Layer 2Relayer, bridge, oracleCác dịch vụ node-as-a-service
Điều này khiến “phi tập trung trên lý thuyết” khác xa “phi tập trung trong thực tế”. Khi chỉ một nhóm nhỏ hiểu được toàn bộ hệ thống, khả năng tự kiểm chứng của cộng đồng giảm xuống — và đó là điều Vitalik coi là mối đe dọa dài hạn.
Một Ethereum đơn giản hơn đồng nghĩa với:
Nhiều người có thể chạy node hơnCode dễ audit hơnÍt phụ thuộc vào các “điểm tập trung mềm”Mạng lưới khó bị thao túng về mặt chính trị và kinh tế hơn
Đây là tư duy xây nền móng lâu dài, không phải cho một chu kỳ tăng giá.
Ở góc độ thị trường, thông điệp này không phải chất xúc tác tăng giá ngay lập tức cho ETH. Nhưng dài hạn, đây lại là tin rất tốt cho ETH. Với tầm nhìn dài hạn, lời kêu gọi của Vitalik củng cố vị thế ETH như:
Tài sản nền tảng (base asset) của Web3Một “Internet settlement layer” đáng tin cậyHạ tầng tài chính phi tập trung chứ không chỉ là playground cho lợi nhuận ngắn hạn
👉 Nếu Ethereum giữ được : Phi tín nhiệm thực, phi tập trung thực và khả năng tự kiểm chứng rộng rãi . Thì ETH không chỉ là “coin nền tảng”, mà trở thành tài sản trung tâm của hệ sinh thái crypto toàn cầu — tương tự vai trò của Bitcoin, nhưng ở lớp ứng dụng.
👉 Hold lâu dài rất tiềm năng

subTitle:
Ondo Finance وLayerZero تطلقان جسرا جديدا لتوسيع تداول الأوراق المالية المميزة
$BNB        $HOME 
{future}(BNBUSDT)
{future}(ETHUSDT)
{alpha}(560x4bfaa776991e85e5f8b1255461cbbd216cfc714f)
أعلنت شركتا أوندو فايننس (Ondo Finance) ولايرزيرو (LayerZero)، المتخصصة في تشغيل سلاسل الكتل المختلفة، عن إطلاق جسر تقني جديد يهدف إلى توسيع حركة الأوراق المالية المميزة (Tokenized Securities) عبر الشبكات وفقا لتقرير نشره موقع crypto.news.
ويسمح "أوندو بريدج" للمستخدمين بنقل أكثر من ١٠٠ سهم وصندوق متداول في البورصة (ETF) مميز رقميا بين شبكتي إيثريوم $ETH  و BNB Chain، مع خطط للتوسع ليشمل شبكات متوافقة أخرى مع آلة إيثريوم ETH الافتراضية (EVM) في المستقبل.

آلية العمل الجسر الجديد والفائدة منه:
وبحسب الموقع يعمل الجسر الجديد على ربط أصول أوندو جلوبال ماركتس عبر السلاسل بمساواة تامة (1:1)، مما يضمن بقاء الرموز المميزة مدعومة بالكامل أثناء انتقالها بين الشبكات، وتعد هذه التقنية تطورا مهما، حيث تحل محل الإعداد القديم الذي كان يعتمد على عقود جسر منفصلة لكل أصل وسلسلة على حدة، مما كان يجعل العملية معقدة وبطيئة.
ويبنى الجسر على هيكل رسائل LayerZero، مما يسمح لأوندو بإدارة عمليات النقل عبر السلاسل من خلال هندسة معمارية واحدة موحدة بدلا من الجسور الخاصة بكل أصل، ووفقا للشركة يجعل هذا الإعداد نشر الأوراق المالية المميزة على سلاسل جديدة أسهل بكثير، حيث يمكن إتمام عمليات التكامل خلال أسابيع بدلا من أشهر، ويستفيد النظام من شبكة LayerZero الواسعة، والتي يدعمها بالفعل أكثر من ٢٦٠٠ تطبيق عبر إيثريوم ETH و BNB Chain.

السياق العام والنمو لمنصة أوندو جلوبال ماركتس:
وأشار الموقع إلى أن هذا الإطلاق يأتي في وقت تشهد فيه منصة أوندو جلوبال ماركتس نموا ملحوظا، فمنذ إطلاقها على إيثريوم #ETH  في سبتمبر والتوسع إلى BNB Chain في أكتوبر، نما إجمالي القيمة المقفلة (TVL) في المنصة إلى أكثر من ٣٥٠ مليون دولار، مع تجاوز الحجم التراكمي للتداول حاجز ٢ مليار دولار.
كما يمثل الإطلاق دفعة تنظيمية كبيرة للشركة، حيث أغلقت هيئة الأوراق المالية والبورصات الأمريكية (SEC) تحقيقها في أوندو فايننس في وقت سابق من هذا الشهر، ويزيل هذا القرار غيمة تنظيمية كانت عالقة فوق الشركة، مما يمنحها مزيدا من الحرية والثقة لمواصلة التوسع في عالم الأوراق المالية المتوافقة مع الأنظمة على سلسلة الكتل.

title: ETH 12/18 今天怎么进场
subTitle:
① 一句话结论
这不是趋势反转，是下跌末段的“清算 + 吸筹复合结构”。主力当前核心目标是：2800 下方再榨一刀 → 建仓完成 → 回到 2950–3050 区间。直接 V 反转概率不高，但“下破—快速拉回”的概率很高。大白话：现在是在压你最后一点耐心，不是要一路砸穿。

② 第一层｜方向 & 市场状态（状态模型）
市场状态：启动前 · 下杀末期
结构：4H 连续下行，但下跌斜率放缓，K线实体明显缩短。
清算池（1D / 1W）：下方 2780–2750 为本轮最大多头清算池（A级），上方 3000–3200 清算持续肥厚。
OI：仍处高位震荡区，没有恐慌式坍塌。
资金流：合约 30m–1H 持续流出，但 8H 以上出现流出减速信号。
订单簿：2800 附近多平台真实买墙，上方 3000–3050 卖墙密集，典型“先杀下再拉”。
OBV / MAOBV：OBV 仍在 MAOBV 下方，只允许试探仓，不允许重仓格局。
大额成交：2800–2850 区域多次出现对价吸收型大单。
Meta-8 模式：暴力清算（Flash Sweep）→ 横盘吸筹切换前。
③ 第二层｜主力路线判断（三条固定路线）
主线 A（≈65%）：2800–2750 扫清算 → 快速拉回 2900 上方 → 2950–3050 震荡修复。确认点：4H 下破 2800 后不出现持续放量，30m/1H 出现长下影线且 OI 不再下降。偏离点：跌破 2750 后连续 4H 实体放量。切换点：有效失守 2700（收盘价）。
副线 B（≈25%）：2790–2800 假破不深插 → 直接反拉 2950。确认点：2800 连续两根 4H 不破，买墙持续补单 ≥30 分钟。偏离点：买墙快速撤单并伴随主动卖出放大。切换点：跌破 2780。
危险线 C（≈10%）：跌破 2700 → 指向 2620–2550。触发条件：BTC 同步失守关键结构，合约资金 4H 级别持续加速流出。当前数据不支持，仅作风控预案。

④ 关键价位大地图
下方主力必打区：2880–2850（前高成交密集区，反抽型，不可格局）；2800–2780（清算 + 买墙 + 大单吸收，试探仓首选）；2750–2720（1D+1W 清算重叠，极限插针重仓区）；2700（结构生死线）。
上方拉盘目标：2950–3000（第一修复位）；3050–3100（趋势确认位）；3200+（下一轮逼空区，非当前阶段）。

⑤ 双向点位体系（全部可执行）
多单体系：
多 A｜试探型：进场 2800–2780；风险点 2750；失效点 2700；极限位 2720；目标 2920–3000；性质：不可格局。
多 B｜极限反转（大肉·PDM Pre）：进场 2750–2720；风险点 2680；失效点 2620；极限位 2550；目标 3000 → 3150；性质：结构级，可拿大肉。
空单体系（仅短线）：
空 A｜反抽空：进场 2980–3020；前提 反抽无量；风险点 3060；失效点 3100；目标 2850；性质：短空，不能扛。
空 B｜破位追空：仅当 2700 有效跌破后才成立，不推荐提前参与。

⑥ 主力节奏判断
当前节奏：试探 → 清算前摇。尚未进入启动阶段，但已经在为启动做仓位清洗。

⑦ 今日最优执行策略
无仓位：2800–2780 小仓占位，2750–2720 才是主力肉区。不追多、不赌反转，等插针送钱，而不是追着送钱。

⑧ 风险提醒
步骤一仍存在更深插针风险；4H 未出现趋势反转信号前严禁满仓；OBV 未上穿 MAOBV 前只允许试探仓。

⑨ 大白话总结
现在更像是主力在磨刀，不是已经砍完。真正舒服、赔率最高的单子，还在 2750 一带等你。

#ETH  In the cryptocurrency world, everyone talks about technology, but what technology can guarantee a 100% profit?
With 5000 yuan aiming to roll to 1 million, here’s an actionable operation.
Phase One: 5,000 → 50,000 (accumulate startup capital, practice feel)
Core goal: Familiarize with the rhythm using spot trading + small leverage, accumulate the first “pressure-free funds.” Start with 5000 yuan in spot: buy BTC and ETH at every major dip, or black swan low point, and sell when it rebounds over 10%, repeating until you double your investment.
Introduce 1x leverage for rolling: When BTC breaks key resistance levels (like 90,000, 100,000), open a long position with 1x leverage, and if you profit 10%, use the floating profit to increase the position by 10%, with a stop loss of 2%. For example, with 20,000 yuan as capital, initially open a position of 2000 yuan, after earning 200 yuan, increase the position by another 200 yuan, keeping the total position not exceeding 10% of the capital.

Phase Two: 50,000 → 300,000 (capture trend markets, amplify profits)
Core goal: Increase the frequency of rolling in a clear trend, speeding up with “wave compound interest.”
Only operate in “certain trends”: For example, when BTC holds above the 30-day moving average on the daily chart, and trading volume increases by more than 3 times, confirm the upward trend before rolling. After the BTC ETF is approved in January 2024, it will be a typical trend market suitable for rolling.
Position increase ratio: For every 15% profit, use 30% of the floating profit to increase the position. For example, with 50,000 yuan as capital and a profit of 15% reaching 57,500 yuan, take out 2,250 yuan (30% of the floating profit of 7,500 yuan) to increase the position, keeping the total position within 20% of the capital.

Phase Three: 300,000 → 1,000,000 (rely on major cycle trends, earn “era dividends”)
Core goal: Capture large market trends during bull-bear transitions, completing a leap with one major trend.
Wait for “historic opportunities”: For example, Bitcoin rises from the bear market bottom (like 15,000) to the mid-bull market (like 60,000), this 5-fold trend can increase rolling returns to over 10 times. In the bull market of 2020-2021, some people rolled 300,000 to 5 million, relying on this kind of major trend.

Ultimate Discipline: Stop rolling once funds reach 900,000, take out 600,000 to store in stablecoins, and continue operating with the remaining 300,000. Remember: the endpoint of rolling is “wealth in hand,” not “rolling forever.”

5000 元想滚到 100 万,讲一个可执行的操作
第一阶段：5 千→5 万（积累启动资金，练手感）
核心目标：用现货 + 小杠杆熟悉节奏，积累第一笔 “无压力资金”。先用 5000 元做现货：在每次暴跌，黑天鹅低点买 BTC、ETH，反弹10%以上出，反复几次，直到翻倍。
加入 1 倍杠杆滚仓：当 BTC 突破关键阻力位（如 9万、10 万），用 1 倍杠杆开多，盈利 10% 就用浮盈加仓 10%，止损 2%。比如 2 万本金，第一次开 2000 元仓位，赚 200 元后，再加 200 元仓位，保持总仓位不超过本金的 10%。

第二阶段：5 万→30 万（抓趋势行情，放大利润）
核心目标：在明确趋势中加大滚仓频率，靠 “波段复利” 提速。
只在 “确定性趋势” 中操作：比如 BTC 日线站稳 30 日线、成交量放大 3 倍以上，确认上升趋势后再滚仓。2024 年 1 月 BTC ETF 通过后，就是典型的趋势行情，适合滚仓。
加仓比例：每盈利 15%，用浮盈的 30% 加仓。比如 5 万本金盈利 15% 到 5.75 万，拿出 2250 元（浮盈 7500 元的 30%）加仓，总仓位控制在本金的 20% 以内。

第三阶段：30 万→100 万（靠大周期趋势，赚 “时代红利”）
核心目标：抓住牛熊转换的大行情，用一次大趋势完成跨越。
等待 “历史性机会”：比如比特币从熊市底部（如 1.5 万）涨到牛市中期（如 6 万），这种 5 倍级别的趋势，滚仓能放大到 10 倍以上收益。2020-2021 年的牛市，有人用 30 万滚到 500 万，靠的就是这种大趋势。

终极纪律：资金到90 万就停止滚仓，拿出60 万存稳定币，剩下 30 万继续操作。记住：滚仓的终点是 “财富落袋”，不是 “永远滚下去”。

title: 18/12 : 540 Triệu USD Bị Thanh Lý ! Phản Ánh Điều Gì ?
subTitle:
Trong 24 giờ qua, thị trường crypto chứng kiến hơn 540 triệu USD lệnh phái sinh bị thanh lý và phần lớn đến từ các vị thế Long
Con số này không chỉ phản ánh một nhịp giảm giá đơn thuần, mà còn cho thấy sự lệch pha nghiêm trọng giữa kỳ vọng của trader và thực tế dòng tiền trên thị trường.
Trong nhiều tuần trước đó, tâm lý chung vẫn là “canh Long khi giảm”. Bitcoin giữ được vùng cao, nhiều altcoin chưa sập sâu, cộng thêm kỳ vọng xu hướng tăng giai đoạn cuối năm khiến không ít nhà đầu tư tin rằng mọi nhịp điều chỉnh chỉ là cơ hội mua vào. Đòn bẩy được sử dụng ngày càng nhiều, funding duy trì ở mức dương, và thị trường phái sinh dần trở nên “nghiêng hẳn một phía”.
Khi giá bắt đầu trượt xuống dưới các mốc hỗ trợ ngắn hạn, lực mua spot không đủ mạnh để hấp thụ lượng bán, trong khi các lệnh Long dùng đòn bẩy cao lần lượt bị chạm ngưỡng thanh lý. Hiệu ứng domino xuất hiện: giá giảm → thanh lý Long → ép bán thêm → giá giảm sâu hơn. Chỉ trong thời gian ngắn, hàng trăm triệu USD bị “bốc hơi” khỏi thị trường phái sinh.
Điều quan trọng nằm ở chỗ: đây không phải là một cú panic sell từ holder dài hạn, mà chủ yếu là sự đào thải của dòng tiền nóng. Những người sử dụng đòn bẩy cao, kỳ vọng thị trường hồi nhanh, đã bị loại khỏi cuộc chơi. Điều này cho thấy một thực tế khá rõ ràng: thị trường hiện tại đang thiếu lực mua chủ động, đặc biệt là từ thị trường spot.
Khi Long bị thanh lý nhiều hơn Short, thông điệp gửi đi rất rõ: bên mua đang yếu thế. Dòng tiền không còn sẵn sàng “đu” giá, cũng không đủ kiên nhẫn để đỡ thị trường khi áp lực bán xuất hiện. Các cá mập và nhà tạo lập, trong bối cảnh đó, không có lý do gì phải kéo giá lên sớm. Ngược lại, họ thường để thị trường tự thanh lọc thêm, buộc những vị thế yếu tay nhất phải rời đi hoàn toàn.
Tuy nhiên, lịch sử crypto cũng cho thấy một mặt khác của vấn đề. Những đợt thanh lý lớn, nếu tập trung chủ yếu vào một phía, thường là bước cần thiết trước khi thị trường tìm lại trạng thái cân bằng. Khi đòn bẩy được giải phóng, funding hạ nhiệt, và tâm lý chuyển từ “tham lam mua đáy” sang “sợ hãi chờ đợi”, thị trường mới bắt đầu hình thành nền giá bền vững hơn.
Nói cách khác, 540 triệu USD bị thanh lý không hẳn là tin xấu tuyệt đối. Với trader ngắn hạn dùng đòn bẩy, đó là một cú đánh đau. Nhưng với nhà đầu tư tỉnh táo, đây là lời nhắc nhở quan trọng: thị trường chưa sẵn sàng cho một nhịp tăng mạnh, và việc bảo toàn vốn lúc này quan trọng hơn việc cố đoán đáy.
Trong giai đoạn như hiện tại, khi lực mua yếu và phái sinh vừa trải qua một đợt “xả đòn bẩy” lớn, chiến lược hợp lý nhất không phải là hành động vội vàng, mà là quan sát phản ứng giá sau thanh lý. Nếu giá tiếp tục trượt với volume thấp, đó là dấu hiệu thị trường còn muốn rũ thêm. Nhưng nếu giá đi ngang, thanh khoản cạn dần và không còn áp lực bán mạnh, khi đó cơ hội thực sự mới bắt đầu hình thành.

CME Group Broadens Crypto Derivatives With Spot-Quoted XRP and Solana Futures

CME Group has expanded its cryptocurrency derivatives portfolio by introducing Spot-Quoted futures for $XRP 
{spot}(XRPUSDT)

XRP and Solana, giving traders access to contracts that closely follow live spot market prices.

These newly launched products are CME’s smallest crypto futures contracts so far, designed for active traders who prefer spot-style pricing without the complexity of dealing with contract expirations or rolling positions forward.

The structure of these contracts is similar to CME’s existing Spot-Quoted Bitcoin and Ether futures, which were introduced earlier this year. Unlike traditional futures that may trade at a premium or discount due to financing costs, Spot-Quoted futures closely track the underlying asset’s spot price, with financing adjustments handled separately at settlement.

According to Giovanni Vicioso, Global Head of Cryptocurrency Products at CME Group, demand for Spot-Quoted Bitcoin and Ether futures has been strong, with over 1.3 million contracts traded since their June launch. Building on this momentum, CME is now extending the same model to XRP and $SOL 
{spot}(SOLUSDT)

Solana.

Since their introduction, Spot-Quoted BTC and $ETH ETH contracts have averaged 11,300 contracts in daily trading volume, reaching a peak of 60,700 contracts on November 24, highlighting growing institutional interest.

In addition to the new futures, CME has also enabled Trading at Settlement (TAS) for XRP, SOL, and their respective Micro futures. TAS allows traders to enter positions at a spread relative to the official 4:00 p.m. ET settlement price, even before that final price is known.

This feature is commonly used to manage exposure related to crypto ETFs, particularly during net asset value (NAV) creation and redemption. It also supports block trades and anonymous execution through the CME Globex platform, offering greater flexibility in trade execution.

translatedData.content:
Japan's interest rate hike poses risks to virtual currencies primarily in three areas: tightening liquidity, unwinding yen arbitrage trades, and rising risk aversion. The specific impacts are as follows:

---

1. Unwinding yen arbitrage trades directly withdraws funds from the crypto market.
Japan has long maintained low interest rates, allowing investors to borrow low-cost yen and invest in high-yield assets (such as U.S. stocks and cryptocurrencies). Once interest rates are raised, the yen appreciates, borrowing costs increase, and arbitrage trades must be unwound, causing funds to flow back to Japan and leading to a sell-off of global risk assets, with cryptocurrencies suffering the most due to their high volatility.

- After the interest rate hike in July 2024, Bitcoin plummeted from $65,000 to $50,000, a decrease of 26%, with the total market value of cryptocurrencies evaporating by $600 billion.
- The current global yen arbitrage trading volume exceeds $1 trillion, with some funds directly flowing into the crypto market.

---

2. Tightening liquidity equates to "reverse quantitative easing."
An interest rate hike indicates tightening global liquidity, especially under the backdrop of Japan being the "last bastion of zero interest rates" shifting towards tightening. This leads to rising global funding costs, reduced risk appetite, and a reassessment of valuations for high-risk assets such as cryptocurrencies.

- Bitcoin is viewed by some investors as the "child of liquidity bubbles," and once liquidity recedes, prices can easily experience sharp corrections.
---

3. Yen appreciation triggers a chain reaction, exacerbating market volatility.
An interest rate hike in Japan is usually accompanied by yen appreciation, and a drop in the USD/JPY exchange rate will trigger a repricing of global risk assets, with cryptocurrencies, being high-risk assets, experiencing much greater fluctuations than traditional markets.

- Data shows that for every 5-point drop in USD/JPY, Bitcoin averages a correction of 8%-12%.
- If USD/JPY falls below 130, it could trigger the largest scale of arbitrage trade unwinding in history, pushing cryptocurrencies into a bear market.

---

4. Deteriorating market sentiment and increased leverage liquidations exacerbate declines.
After the interest rate hike expectations materialize, market panic escalates, the VIX index surges, and leveraged funds in the crypto market are forcibly liquidated, creating a vicious cycle of "decline-liquidation-redecline."

- In December 2025, the crypto market saw evaporations of about $300 million due to interest rate hike expectations, with 87% being liquidations of long positions.
- Bitcoin's beta coefficient is as high as 2.2, meaning that for every 1% drop in U.S. stocks, Bitcoin averages a 2.2% drop.
Above are personal opinions #BTC #ETH

日本加息对虚拟货币的风险主要体现在流动性收紧、日元套利交易平仓和避险情绪升温三个方面，具体影响如下：

---

1. 日元套利交易平仓，直接抽离加密市场资金
日本长期维持低利率，投资者借入低成本日元，转投高收益资产（如美股、加密货币）。一旦加息，日元升值、借贷成本上升，套利交易被迫平仓，资金回流日本，导致全球风险资产被抛售，加密货币作为高波动资产首当其冲。

- 2024年7月日本加息后，比特币从6.5万美元暴跌至5万美元，跌幅达26%，加密市场总市值蒸发6000亿美元。
- 当前全球日元套利交易规模超过1万亿美元，其中部分资金直接流入加密市场。

---

2. 流动性收紧，等同于“逆向量化宽松”
加息意味着全球流动性收紧，尤其在日本是“最后一个零利率堡垒”转向紧缩的背景下，全球资金成本上升，风险偏好下降，加密货币等高风险资产面临估值重估。

- 比特币被部分投资者视为“流动性泡沫之子”，一旦流动性退潮，价格容易剧烈回调。
---

3. 日元升值引发连锁反应，加剧市场波动
日本加息通常伴随日元升值，美元/日元汇率下降会触发全球风险资产重新定价，加密货币作为高”资产，波动幅度远大于传统市场。

- 数据显示，美元/日元每下跌5个点，比特币平均回调8%-12%。
- 若美元/日元跌破130，可能引发史上最大规模套利交易平仓，加密货币或进入熊市。

---

4. 市场情绪恶化，杠杆清算加剧下跌
加息预期或落地后，市场恐慌情绪升温，VIX指数飙升，加密市场杠杆资金被强制平仓，形成“下跌-清算-再下跌”的恶性循环。

- 2025年12月，加密市场因加息预期蒸发约3亿美元，87%为多头清算。
- 比特币β系数高达2.2，即美股跌1%，比特币平均跌2.2%

市场不缺机会，缺的是能活下来的人。

Many people think of "rolling positions" as soon as they hear it—

 getting rich overnight, going all in, and living on the edge.

But those who can truly roll their positions larger have never relied on luck, but on position management + disciplined execution.

 1. A position is not better when it's larger, but rather when it's steadier to win.

I have also gone all in, and after three stop losses, my account evaporated by one-third.

Only later did I understand:

👉 Position management is the "heart" of the trading system.

My core principle is:

🔸 Keep the main position at 30%~40%, leaving the rest for maneuvering.

🔸 Additional positions must be confirmed by trends, no guessing bottoms or chasing tops.

🔸 A single loss exceeding 2% means a mandatory three-day break.

This is not cowardice, but a chance for the account to "recover".

Stability is to allow for longer rolling.

 2. Compound interest rolling: not through huge profits, but through stable small wins.

Many people fantasize about doubling their position in one go, but true experts rely on continuous small victories.

For example👇

A daily net growth of 1% means 34% in a month and 3778% in a year.

Sounds exaggerated?

But the prerequisite is—you must not incur losses!

Every time I trade, I follow a "three-step" approach:

1️! Write down stop-loss points in advance, not relying on feelings.

2️⃣ Only trade in directions I understand.

3️⃣ Lock in profits to prevent drawdowns.

These may seem simple, but they are the dividing line between "those who can roll" and "those who get rolled over".

 3. Market conditions are unpredictable, but positions can save lives.

The crypto world changes every day,

Some get rich, while others face liquidation.

The difference is summed up in one sentence:

 Has anyone taught you how to hold on and how to let go?

I've seen too many ups and downs on Binance, and those who can last are the ones who "understand the rhythm".

 4. I am currently conducting an experiment

Using three months to gradually amplify a small amount of capital through systematic rolling,

Not by fighting hard, not by gambling with life, but relying on rhythm and discipline.

I won’t say this is "guaranteed profit",

But I dare say every step has logic and rules.

#ETH #ZEC #Pippin

content:
很多人一听到“滚仓”，脑子里立刻想到的是——

 一夜暴富、满仓梭哈、命悬一线。

但真正能把仓位滚大的人，从来不是靠运气，而是靠仓位管理 + 纪律执行。

 一、仓位不是越大越好，而是越稳越能赢

我也曾满仓冲进去，三次止损后账户直接蒸发三分之一。

后来我才明白：

👉 仓位管理，才是交易系统的“心脏”。

我的核心原则是：

🔸主仓控制在 30%~40%，剩下留作机动。

🔸加仓必须趋势确认，不猜底不抄顶。

🔸 单笔亏损超 2% 就强制休息三天。

这不是怂，而是为了让账户有“回血的机会”。

稳，是为了能滚得更久。

 二、复利滚仓：不是靠暴利，而是靠稳定的小胜

很多人幻想一单翻倍，但真正的高手，靠的是持续的小胜。

举个例子👇

每天净增长 1%，一个月就是 34%，一年是 3778%。

听起来夸张？

可前提是——你必须不亏！

我每次交易都执行“三步走”：

1️！提前写止损点，不凭感觉。

2️⃣ 只做自己懂的方向。

3️⃣ 赚了就锁仓，防止回撤。

这些看似简单，却是区分“能滚的人”和“被卷的人”的分水岭。

 三、行情无常，但仓位能救命

币圈每天都在变，

有人暴富，也有人爆仓。

区别只有一句话：

 有没有人教过你，怎么拿得住，怎么放得下。

我在币安上见过太多起落，最后能留下的，都是“懂节奏”的人。

 四、我最近在做一个实验

用三个月，把一笔小资金通过系统性滚仓逐步放大，

不拼命，不赌命，只靠节奏和纪律。

我不会说这是“稳赚”，

但我敢说，每一步都有逻辑、有章法。

title: 🚨 ETHGas Picks Up $12M to Make Ethereum Transactions Feel Instant and Gasless
subTitle:
Something actually important is happening on Ethereum right now, and for once, it’s not another derivative token launch or some next-gen L2 hype cycle that nobody asked for.
ETHGas just pulled in $12M led by Polychain. The timing here is a massive "tell." It landed almost immediately after Vitalik started posting about onchain gas futures, this specific idea that blockspace shouldn't feel like a game of roulette every time you try to swap a token.
If you’ve ever sat there staring at a pending transaction while gas spikes from 15 to 150 gwei, you know the feeling. It’s broken. You should be able to see a price, lock it in, and move on with your life.
That is the exact nerve ETHGas is hitting.
Instead of just tossing a transaction into the mempool and praying to the MEV gods, they’re basically letting you pre-buy execution. We’re talking actual time slices, tiny ~50ms windows. If you genuinely care about when your transaction lands (which, let’s be real, is everyone trying to actually use DeFi), you can reserve that slot instead of fighting an army of bots in a blind auction.
The tech under the hood is actually pretty slick. They’re breaking blocks into chunks and getting validators to commit early. For traders or infra teams who’ve watched their margins get eaten by fee randomness, this isn't just a "feature update." It’s a shift from Ethereum behaving like a chaotic crowd to it functioning like an actual system.
But let's be honest: it's going to be messy.
The second you have validators pre-committing to blocks, you’re introducing a massive coordination headache. And in crypto, coordination always has a price. ETHGas isn’t sugarcoating it, they’re talking about leader selection and slashing risks. This isn’t a polished, finished product. It’s a high-stakes, live experiment.
Here’s my actual takeaway:
I don’t even care if ETHGas specifically becomes the winner here. What matters is the direction the wind is blowing. We’re finally treating blockspace like real infrastructure, something you plan for and hedge against, not just digital chaos you react to.
Vitalik’s recent posts weren't just random thought bubbles. They were a signal that the move fast and break things era of gas is ending.
Ethereum isn't just trying to get faster anymore.
It’s trying to become predictable.
That’s a much more mature, and frankly much more interesting, phase to be in.

title: 《爆仓 200 多次，他却还在不停开多：麻吉大哥到底在玩什么？》
subTitle:
一、先说结论

“不停开多、表面持续亏损”本身，并不等于他在别处一定盈利；但在职业交易与资金运作体系中，这种行为“完全可能是理性的”。这不是阴谋论，同样也不天真。这个事情的关键不在于单边多单是否亏钱，而在于：他是不是 在同一个账户、同一个维度里“真的在亏”，以及 他的盈利目标是否与你看到的那部分一致。

二、从专业角度看，可能存在的三种真实情况
情况一：他就是在执行「高确定性方向 + 高容错试错」的策略

这是最“朴素”、但也最容易被散户误解的一种。

核心逻辑：

他对中长期方向（比如 BTC 牛市）有强信念

短周期不断用小仓位试多

错了就止损，直到等到趋势真正启动

你看到的是：

多单 → 止损 → 多单 → 再止损

但你没看到的是：

每一笔的风险暴露是极低的

一旦抓到主升段，一次就覆盖前面 N 次亏损

这在趋势交易里非常常见，看起来像“一直亏”，本质是在“等那一次”。

📌 对旁观者来说很难受，但对资金体量大、执行力强的人来说，这是标准打法。

情况二：他并不是靠「方向盈利」，而是靠「结构盈利」

这一点，普通人几乎看不到。

可能的组合包括：

现货重仓 + 合约频繁止损对冲

期权结构（买 Gamma / 卖 Theta）

多账户体系：展示账户 ≠ 盈利账户

举个不带阴谋的例子：

他可能在一个“公开可见”的账户里频繁做多止损
同时在另一个账户或产品中，

持有大量低成本现货

或通过期权、OTC、场外结构锁定收益

你看到的亏损，更像是：

成本、保险费、或波动博弈的必要支出

📌 这不是“割粉”，而是专业资金的常见操作方式。（当然，这里需要说明一点是，以上的方式行业中客观存在的资金运作范式，本人监控不到麻吉大哥的隐形账户，给不出明确的证据，仅供参考~）

情况三：他赚的不是交易 PnL，而是“交易之外的价值”

这是最容易被忽略、但现实中非常普遍的一种。

比如：

影响力本身就是资产

持续表达多头立场，有助于：

维护其圈层地位

稳定其品牌叙事

放大其在其他项目、股权、场外合作中的收益

在这种情况下：

交易本身不是利润中心

而是叙事、立场、话语权的延伸工具

📌 从商业视角看，这未必是坏事，但与你作为纯交易者的目标是完全不同的。

三、但要警惕的，是另一种更危险的误解

很多人会下意识得出一个结论：

“他敢一直亏着开多，一定在别的地方赚大钱，我也可以。”

这是对普通交易者最致命的认知错误。

需要非常清楚三点差异：

资金体量不同：他能承受的试错成本，不是你能承受的

信息维度不同：你看到的是行为，他掌握的是结构

盈利来源不同：你只靠交易，他未必

四、如果站在普通交易者的角度，真正该学的不是“模仿”，而是“反向提炼”

可以从他身上学到的，只有三点是有价值的：

方向和节奏是两回事
看对大方向，不等于要在每一根 K 线上都赚钱

亏损不可怕，失控才可怕
如果每一笔亏损都是事先计算好的，那它是成本，不是失败

不要把别人的“系统行为”，当成自己的“单笔信号”

最后一句很重要的话

高手的亏损，看起来像愚蠢；
散户的模仿，往往才是真正的愚蠢。

Ethereum is expected to increase its gas limit to 80 million in January 2026.

Ethereum network transaction throughput will increase again next month, with developers planning to raise the Ethereum gas cap from 60 million to 80 million in January. 

Christine Kim, VP of Research at Galaxy Digital, shared a summary of Monday's all-core developer meeting, in which a Nethermind representative stated that developers should prepare to push forward with the gas cap increase after the next BPO hard fork on January 7th. However, Barnabas Busa, Developer Operations Engineer at the Ethereum Foundation, pointed out that two client-level optimizations need to be completed before raising the block gas cap again: partial Blob responses at the execution layer and the setting of the maximum Blob flag at the consensus layer. 

All Ethereum core developer participants will meet again on January 5th to confirm when to raise the gas cap after the second BPO hard fork. The first BPO hard fork took place on December 9th, increasing blob capacity by 66%; the second hard fork on January 7th is expected to increase it by another 66%. Ethereum developers and research community members have reached a consensus to increase the network's gas limit to 180 million by the end of 2026.

Bitcoin's 5% volatility was not a coincidence — the charts reveal the full story

December 18, 2025, 07:07 GMT+1

￼BTCUSD‪+1.11%‬

The violent movement of Bitcoin on December 17 surprised traders. In one day, the price of Bitcoin jumped to about $90,500 before sharply reversing and sliding towards $85,200. From peak to trough, that was a shift of over 5%, or about $5,000.

This was not driven by news. It was driven by the structure. Three charts explain why this move occurred, why it stopped exactly where it did, and why similar volatility remains possible.

Volume spikes signal risks before the drop

Before the sell-off, the movement of Bitcoin's price was already showing pressure. Between December 15 and 17, Bitcoin's price recorded a marginally higher low on the daily chart. On the surface, it appeared stable. But the On-Balance Volume (OBV) told a different story.

OBV tracks whether volume confirms price movements. During this period, OBV failed to follow the price increase and instead made a lower low. That bearish divergence was a signal of distribution. In simple terms, the price was stable, but selling volume was quietly flowing.

【If ETH is really going to move, this period may be crucial】

The night trading has just started, and the rhythm of ETH has clearly changed.

For the past few days, I've been watching this position, and the fluctuations around 2850 are making people a bit drowsy, but the more I look at it, the more I feel it's not without reason. The RSI is stuck around 45, neither up nor down, as if it's waiting for some signal. At times like this, the worst thing is to react with excitement; a small bullish candle during the day leads to calls of a breakout, and then dropping two trades at night gets people saying it's topped out, which is really unnecessary. The current phase feels more like a consolidation after a pullback; the volume hasn't increased, but it also can't be pushed down, indicating that the buying below isn't weak.

I've looked at the structure, and the next likely paths are: one is to continue sideways to consume time, gradually narrowing the moving average system, and then suddenly a big bullish candle appears, directly testing the recent range area—this approach is stable and suitable for those who can hold; the other is to first smash down, breaking through recent lows, washing out the last batch of floating chips before pulling back up. I've seen both of these paths too many times, the difference lies in whether the main force wants to take the easy route.
If you're stuck, consider it tuition paid to the market.

From the performance of these past few days, there are signs of strength. While other altcoins have wilted, ETH can still hold this price, indicating that funds haven't completely withdrawn. Moreover, after the night trading started, buying responses have been more active than the previous two days; at least when the selling pressure emerges, there are buyers ready, which is not mindless optimism but details observed.

Of course, it's still early to talk about direction. The RSI at 45.1 cannot be said to be oversold, nor has it reached overheating; it's just at a position that can guide. If it can stand above 47 and stabilize, then the sentiment will gradually warm up; if it gets pushed back below 40, then it will have to continue grinding.

Rationality tells me to wait, but my hands are a bit unruly.

I don't recommend heavily betting at this time, but if you already have a base position, you can fully utilize this volatility to make some rhythm. Don't chase, and don't panic; real opportunities often appear when most people lose patience. If this wave is really going to move, this consolidation period may be key. Anyway, I will continue to watch; if it doesn't move, that's fine, but if it does, I hope it can have some decent continuity.

当前价格已跌破2900美元关键心理关口，接近资金吸筹区间2782.19-2806.78。这一绿色标注的“吸筹区”带有向上箭头，表明这里可能是机构或大户的低位积累区域。如果ETH能在2780美元上方企稳，形成有效支撑，则可能引发短期反弹，甚至测试3200美元附近的第一个阻力。小时图显示多头动能不足，RSI指标可能已进入超卖区，但尚未出现明显背离信号。结合近期鲸鱼抛售压力和宏观不确定性，空头仍占上风。但如果跌至吸筹区后成交量放大、出现锤头线或吞没形态，则“空头陷阱”概率增大——多头可能借机反击，推动价格快速回补至3300美元以上。

title: La meilleure stratégie en trading ?😱
subTitle:
Sur ce graphique, vous verrez une analyse que j'ai effectué sur l'#Ethereum ETH/USDT en wkly
L’une des croyances les plus répandues dans le trading consiste à penser qu’il existerait une stratégie universelle, capable de fonctionner en toutes circonstances et sur tous les marchés. Cette idée est séduisante, car elle promet simplicité et sécurité. Pourtant, elle est fondamentalement erronée. Les marchés financiers ne sont pas statiques : ils évoluent, changent de régime et alternent entre différentes phases. Chercher une stratégie unique revient à ignorer la nature même des marchés.

Une stratégie ne vaut que dans son environnement

En finance de marché, une stratégie n’a jamais de valeur absolue. Elle n’existe que relativement à un environnement donné.
Un marché peut être :
- tendanciel,
- en range,
- fortement volatil,
- ou au contraire très compressé.

Une stratégie de suivi de tendance peut exceller dans un marché directionnel, mais devenir inefficace voire destructrice dans un marché sans direction claire. À l’inverse, une stratégie de retour à la moyenne peut être pertinente dans un marché stable, mais subir des pertes rapides lors d’un changement de régime.
Les travaux académiques sur les régimes de marché montrent précisément cela : la performance d’une approche dépend moins de la méthode elle-même que du contexte dans lequel elle est appliquée. Une stratégie rentable dans un régime peut avoir une espérance négative dans un autre.

La pluralité des stratégies : une nécessité, pas un luxe

Les acteurs professionnels ne raisonnent jamais en “stratégie unique”. Les hedge funds, les desks institutionnels ou les gestionnaires multi-assets utilisent des portefeuilles de stratégies. Pourquoi ?
Parce qu’aucune approche ne domine durablement tous les environnements.

Certaines stratégies exploitent :
- la tendance,
- la volatilité,
- les écarts de valorisation,
- les flux,
- ou les anomalies temporaires.

Cette pluralité permet :
- de lisser la performance,
- de réduire la dépendance à un seul régime,
- d’augmenter la robustesse dans le temps.

Ce principe est bien connu en gestion quantitative : une stratégie peut afficher une performance attractive sur plusieurs années simplement parce que le marché lui est favorable, puis s’effondrer lorsque le régime change. La diversification stratégique est donc une réponse directe à l’incertitude structurelle des marchés.

Les marchés évoluent en permanence

L’erreur la plus courante consiste à analyser les marchés comme s’ils étaient stables. En réalité, ils sont influencés par :
- la politique monétaire,
- les cycles économiques,
- les flux de liquidité,
- la réglementation,

la structure des participants (algorithmes, CTA, options).
Un environnement de taux bas n’implique pas les mêmes comportements qu’un environnement de taux élevés. De la même manière, un marché dominé par la liquidité n’obéit pas aux mêmes dynamiques qu’un marché dominé par la contraction du crédit. Ces changements modifient la structure même du prix, de la volatilité et des réactions techniques.
Trader sans tenir compte de cette évolution revient à utiliser une carte qui n’est plus à jour.

L’adaptation comme compétence centrale du trader

La véritable compétence en trading n’est pas la maîtrise d’une stratégie, mais la capacité à :
identifier le régime de marché,
comprendre ce que le marché est en train de pricer,
ajuster son approche en conséquence.
Cela implique parfois :

- de réduire son activité,
- de changer d’horizon temporel,
- ou même de ne pas trader du tout.

Les traders durables ne sont pas ceux qui appliquent une méthode rigide, mais ceux qui savent quand ne pas l’utiliser.

Conclusion:
Il n’existe pas de “meilleure stratégie” en trading, car les marchés ne cessent de changer. La performance durable ne vient pas d’une formule magique, mais d’une compréhension profonde des environnements de marché et d’une capacité d’adaptation constante. La pluralité des stratégies n’est pas un aveu de faiblesse, c’est une reconnaissance lucide de la complexité des marchés. En trading, ce n’est pas la stratégie parfaite qui fait la différence, mais la capacité à évoluer au rythme du marché.

Si tu aimes le trading, la finance et l’économie, tu es au bon endroit.
Abonne-toi et partage

📊 HOW INFLATION DATA IMPACTS CRYPTO ⁉️

Inflation data quietly drives the crypto market, even when charts don’t immediately show it.

🔥 High inflation:

Central banks stay aggressive → interest rates remain high

Liquidity stays tight → risk assets like crypto face selling pressure

Traders pull capital → volatility spikes, short-term downside likely

❄️ Cooling inflation:

Markets price in rate cuts → monetary conditions ease

Liquidity returns → Bitcoin often rallies first, then $ETH , then altcoins

Soft CPI data can trigger strong upside moves

⚠️ On inflation release days:

The first move is rarely the real one

Fast spikes, fake breakouts, and sharp reversals are common

Real direction emerges after the dollar index and bond yields stabilize

💡 Simple rule:

Hot inflation = pressure on crypto

Cooling inflation = opportunity

Liquidity expectations matter more than headlines

title: What “ETH exchange supply at 2016 lows” actually means
subTitle:
When the exchange supply ratio drops to multi-year (or decade) lows, it tells us one thing clearly:
➡️ ETH is being moved off exchanges faster than it’s being sent to them
That usually reflects intent, not just activity.
Why this is important now
1. Reduced sell-side pressure
Fewer ETH sitting on exchanges = fewer coins immediately available to sellThis dampens the impact of downside volatilityEven modest spot demand can move price more aggressively when supply is thin
2. Behavior shift toward holding, not trading
ETH holders are choosing self-custody, staking, or DeFi over centralized liquidityThis aligns with:Staking yield becoming a core ETH narrativeL2 usage abstracting ETH away from exchangesInstitutional custody solutions post-ETF era

3. Divergence vs price = compression
Price has pulled back while exchange supply keeps fallingHistorically, this kind of divergence often precedes volatility expansion, not continuation of chopIt doesn’t guarantee direction, but it increases the odds of sharp moves once demand returns
Why this cycle is different from past ones
In prior cycles:
Exchange outflows usually happened after price runs
This cycle:
Outflows are happening during consolidation and pullbacks
That suggests:
Less panic sellingMore structural holdingA market increasingly driven by positioning and liquidity, not fear
What would invalidate the signal?
Watch for:
A sustained uptick in exchange inflows (especially from large wallets)Spikes in ETH deposited to exchanges during rallies (distribution behavior)
Absent that, the data supports the idea that ETH downside is becoming supply-constrained.
Bottom line
This chart doesn’t scream “moon tomorrow” — but it does say:
Sellers are scarceHolders are patientAny future demand shock (ETF flows, macro easing, L2 growth) has less resistance overhead
In quiet markets, supply dynamics matter more than narratives, and right now ETH’s supply setup is quietly constructive.

title: Crypto Treasuries Attract $2.6B as Institutions Seek Stability Amid Volatility
subTitle:
Digital asset treasuries pulled in more than $2.6 billion over the past two weeks, marking their strongest inflow in over seven weeks, even as crypto prices remain volatile. The bulk of this institutional capital flowed into Bitcoin and Ethereum treasuries, reinforcing their status as preferred high-liquidity assets during uncertain market conditions.

In Brief Despite cautious sentiment across markets, institutional allocators increased exposure to crypto treasuries following recent macro shifts. Bitcoin and Ethereum led the inflows, with large players stepping in aggressively.

Key Highlights

Digital Asset Treasuries recorded $2.6B+ in inflows over two weeks after the Fed’s rate cut — the highest level in roughly seven weeks.

Bitcoin and Ethereum dominated, drawing around $940M into BTC and $423M into ETH, while smaller allocations went to niche assets.

Major buyers were active, with Strategy acquiring nearly $2B worth of BTC across two December purchases.

Tailwinds include the December 10 Fed rate cut, which improved liquidity and reduced financing costs, and new FASB accounting rules allowing crypto gains to be recognized as net income.

The trend points to a flight-to-quality, as institutions favor deep-liquidity assets like BTC and ETH during market uncertainty.

Why It Matters Institutional treasurers are repositioning as macro liquidity improves and balance-sheet treatment of crypto becomes more favorable. In risk-off environments, capital gravitates toward assets with scale, liquidity, and resilience — and Bitcoin and Ethereum continue to fill that role for serious allocators.

translatedData.content:
#zec  I didn't turn my life around the day I learned to make money, but the moment I learned to 'give in'.

When I first started trading contracts, I did the stupidest thing, which was to hold on to my positions.

When the market turned against me, the only thought in my mind was: wait a little longer, it will surely bounce back.

#BEATUSDT  What was the result?

At three in the morning, watching my margin being eaten away bit by bit,

until the reminder popped up, and my mind went blank.

Later, I understood one thing:

#ETH  The market never takes care of those who hesitate.

Once you are in, you should get out.

Taking a loss is not shameful; stubbornly holding on is what truly looks bad.

#solana  Later on, I set a 'lifeline' for myself:

If I make five consecutive mistakes, I will immediately cut off.

Once, the market was as chaotic as a meat grinder, and I stubbornly refused to believe it,

I didn't accept the mistakes in the first three trades,

but the fifth trade directly wiped out all the profits from the past two weeks.

At that moment, I finally woke up—

When emotions are high, you are not trading; you are giving away money.

Now, as long as I make five consecutive mistakes,

I close the software, leave the market, go for a run, or sleep.

The next day, the structure is often crystal clear,

the previous 'opportunities' were actually all noise.

There's one more thing I've learned after suffering too many losses:

The numbers on the account are all illusions.

Now, for every profit of 3000U, I must take half into a cold wallet.

During that sharp market drop,

I could remain calm, all thanks to the profits I had already locked in.

If the money isn't taken out, it doesn't count as yours.

In volatile markets, I now just take a detour.

In the past, I would impulsively jump in,

only to get swept back and forth, with fees and stop losses,

losing more than in a one-sided market.

Now, I only recognize trends,

If the daily structure is unclear, I'd rather stay in cash.

My positions are tightly controlled.

Years ago, one reckless bet,

wiped out half of my principal in one go.

Now, I limit each trade to a maximum of 10%,

testing with small positions, and if I make a mistake, I can calmly review.

Most people lose not because they can't read the market, but because they are too gambling-prone.

It’s only now that I am sure:

Contracts are not a path to sudden wealth,

but a long-term battle of execution.

Cut losses when you should, stop when you need to, and take profits when it's time.

I previously stumbled around on my own, took too many detours.

I later realized that walking the right path is much more important than running fast.

Now, I have a set of methods that have been repeatedly validated,

which means the road is already paved.

The rest depends on whether you are willing to follow it.

#zec 我不是学会赚钱那天翻身的，是学会“认输”的那一刻

刚玩合约那阵，我干过最蠢的一件事，就是扛单。

行情一反走，脑子里只有一句话：再等等，肯定会拉回去。

#BEATUSDT 结果呢？

凌晨三点，盯着保证金一点点被吃掉，

直到那条提醒跳出来，整个人直接空白。

后来我才明白一件事：

#ETH 市场从不照顾犹豫的人。

到位了，就该走。

认赔不丢人，死扛才是真的难看。

#solana 再后来，我给自己加了一道“保命线”：

连续错五次，立刻熔断。

有次行情乱得像绞肉机，我偏不信邪，

前三单错了还不服，

第五单直接把前两周的利润全吐回去。

那一刻我才清醒——

情绪上头的时候，你不是在交易，是在送钱。

现在只要连错五次，

我就关软件、离场、跑步、睡觉。

第二天再看，结构往往清清楚楚，

之前的“机会”，其实全是噪音。

还有一件事，我吃过太多亏才悟透：

账面数字都是幻觉。

现在每赚 3000U，我必提一半进冷钱包。

行情急跌那次，

我能稳住，全靠之前已经落袋。

钱不提出来，就不算你的。

震荡行情我现在直接绕道走。

以前手痒冲进去，

结果来回扫，手续费加止损，

亏得比单边还狠。

现在只认趋势，

日线结构不明朗，我宁愿空仓。

仓位更是卡得死死的。

当年一把梭哈，

一次就干掉半个本金。

现在每单最多 10%，

小仓试错，错了也能冷静复盘。

多数人输，不是不会看盘，是赌性太重。

走到现在我才确定：

合约不是暴富通道，

是一场执行力的长期战。

该割就割，该停就停，该提就提。

我之前一个人瞎撞，走了太多弯路。

后来才发现，这行走对路，比跑得快重要得多。

现在我这边有一套已经反复验证过的方法，

等于路已经铺好。

剩下的，只看你愿不愿意照着走。

At present, ETH is effectively caught between a possible technical rebound and a deeper breakdown. Importantly, the distance between these two scenarios is narrowing rapidly. While short-term bounce signals are emerging, the breakdown threshold is uncomfortably close, making this a critical moment for traders and investors.
Price Compression Inside a Narrowing Triangle Signals Indecision
Ethereum is trading within a tightening symmetrical triangle, a pattern that typically reflects increasing indecision between buyers and sellers. As price compresses toward the lower trendline, volatility contracts—often preceding a sharp directional move.
Between December 1 and December 17, Ethereum printed a higher low on price, while the Relative Strength Index (RSI) registered a lower low. This divergence represents a form of hidden bullish divergence, suggesting that selling momentum is weakening even as price holds structure.
While this setup does not guarantee a bullish breakout, it does imply that downside pressure may be exhausting as Ethereum approaches structural support near the lower boundary of the triangle. In practical terms, sellers appear to be losing dominance, but buyers have not yet demonstrated sufficient conviction to reclaim control.
This delicate balance makes ETH’s next move extremely level-dependent.
On-Chain Cost Basis Highlights Where Rebounds May Face Heavy Resistance
On-chain cost basis data adds another layer of insight into Ethereum’s short-term outlook, particularly on the upside.
The most significant near-term resistance zone lies between $3,154 and $3,179, where approximately 2.8 million ETH were accumulated. This area represents a dense supply cluster. When price revisits this range, many holders reach their break-even levels, often triggering distribution and profit-taking.
This zone closely aligns with the technical resistance at $3,149, which corresponds to roughly an 11% upside from current price levels. Even if Ethereum manages a rebound, this region is likely to cap upside momentum unless price can secure a clean daily close above it.
Without such confirmation, any rally into this area should be viewed as corrective rather than trend-reversing.
Downside Risk Remains Asymmetrically Close
The downside structure is notably more fragile.
Ethereum’s most critical support cluster sits between $2,801 and $2,823, a range that has historically acted as a strong demand zone. A decisive daily close below $2,801—a level clearly visible on both the price chart and on-chain metrics—would serve as a clear warning signal.
While this would represent only about a 1% downside break, the technical implications are significant. Such a move could quickly expose Ethereum to the next major support around $2,617, marking a substantially deeper corrective phase.
This asymmetry defines Ethereum’s current risk profile: upside potential of roughly 11% faces heavy resistance, while downside risk begins with a relatively small failure of key support.
Final Outlook: A Narrow Margin Between Bounce and Breakdown
Ethereum is positioned at a critical inflection point. Momentum indicators suggest selling pressure is weakening, yet price has not confirmed a sustainable reversal. With strong resistance overhead and fragile support beneath, ETH’s next move will likely be swift and decisive once a key level breaks.
Traders should closely monitor daily closes, particularly around $2,801 support and $3,150 resistance, as these levels are likely to dictate Ethereum’s short-term direction.

The UK and European interest rate decisions; then keep an eye on Japan's interest rate hike; and also the long-term game revealed by the Federal Reserve candidates — the interests behind it are intricate, making it a prolonged battle.

Let's talk about this wave of interest rate hikes in Japan. The market reacted aggressively: foreign capital bought a staggering 1.4 trillion yen in Japanese bonds in a single week (about 9.1 billion USD), and the Japanese people followed suit, transferring deposits from banks to buy government bonds, with individual bond purchases exceeding 50 trillion yen (about 3.2 billion USD) this year, reaching a new high since 2007.
In the past, Japanese bonds were seen as "holding them means no return"; after the rate hike, the yield jumped from nearly 0 to 0.7%. For those used to low returns, this is like finding free money!

Now looking at tonight's European Central Bank, it's clearly "staying put" — inflation is close to the 2% target, and the economy isn't strong enough to warrant a rate hike. Lagarde has also indicated that the probability of not lowering interest rates and maintaining rates is quite high. In the short term, European bond yields simply cannot rise, and compared to Japanese bonds, they have become significantly more attractive.
Foreign capital knows the score; buying Japanese bonds is more profitable than holding European bonds; the Japanese people are more pragmatic, earning only 100 yen from a million yen in the bank for a year, while buying government bonds can yield 7,000 yen, leading to a collective shift of deposits to Japanese bonds. Today's Japanese bonds are undoubtedly the top performers in low-risk, high-return investments!

title: Crypto Treasuries Pull in $2.6 Billion as Institutions Seek Safe Ops Amid Market Uncertainty
subTitle:
Digital Asset Treasuries hauled in $2.6 billion in two weeks, led by $BTC and $ETH trusts, the strongest in more than seven weeks. Fed rate cuts and new accounting rules are pulling allocators back into crypto even as price uncertainty lingers.
Context in a Nutshell
Despite ongoing price volatility and broader market caution, Digital Asset Treasuries recorded over $2.6 billion in inflows over two weeks, the largest in more than seven weeks. This institutional capital surge was concentrated in Bitcoin and Ethereum treasuries, with Strategy making nearly $2 billion in Bitcoin purchases, underscoring a sustained institutional appetite for deep‑liquidity crypto assets even as sentiment softens.
What You Should Know
Digital Asset Treasuries (DATs) captured over $2.6 billion in inflows across a two‑week stretch following the Federal Reserve's rate cut, the highest in roughly seven weeks. The surge highlights institutional appetite for crypto exposure even amid market uncertainty.Bitcoin and Ethereum DATs dominated the move, accounting for about $940 million to Bitcoin and $423 million to Ethereum, with smaller flows to niche products like Bittensor.Major allocators played a significant role; for instance, Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) acquired nearly $2 billion in BTC in two large buys in early and mid‑December.Drivers cited include the December 10 Fed rate cut, which boosted liquidity and lowered leverage costs, and new FASB accounting rules that allow crypto gains to be booked as net income, making treasury allocations more attractive.The flows suggest a "flight to quality" pattern, with institutional capital preferring deep‑liquidity assets such as BTC and ETH in uncertain environments.
Why Does This Matter?
These flows come from institutional treasurers and asset allocators who see strategic value in crypto as macro liquidity conditions shift. The combination of a Federal Reserve rate cut and new accounting rules that let firms book crypto gains as net income has made treasury allocations more attractive and defensible on balance sheets.
In uncertain markets, capital chases quality and liquidity, and Bitcoin and Ethereum are proving they still occupy that role for allocators with real money on the line.
